note: Every value is a SUGGESTION from the profession file. The owner edits it. Nothing here is checked by Rosie (licenses are optional and never checked: D96).

core.field: Website or listing link (read to draft B06 and B07)
About us line

FAQs (question and answer)

Terms accepted (who answers for what)

Groups: size limits and a chaperone count

suggested_services_note: Each row is one way this kind of work takes money (one of the master's 28 paths per flow). The owner keeps the services that fit and picks ONE path per service and place. Names and amounts are examples from the profession file, not prices.

suggested_services.example: A holiday program day for Rafi, 7: $65, paid in full when booking.

suggested_services.name: Free visit

before_times: which program, and the start date
how many children, for a home or school program
a term or a drop-in visit
after_time: anything the teacher should know: a learning need, a language, a fear or a food allergy
secure_page_only: the child's name, age and a waiver, read and signed by the parent or guardian
health notes: allergies, asthma, a seizure note, medicine they carry
an emergency contact and who may pick the child up (a list of adults)
intake_questions.who_may_book: a parent or guardian for each child; a school's office books an in-school program; a child is never booked by someone who isn't on the child's record

stop.words: a child not breathing, unresponsive, or hurt badly right now
stop.say: Call 911 now. Keep the child still, and start first aid if trained.

go_on.words: a learning need, asthma, a food allergy, or a recent injury
go_on.what: the booking goes on; the answer stays on the secure page, and the teacher reads it before the program; Rosie gives no health advice

go_on.words: a child who finds school hard after a loss or a move
go_on.what: the booking goes on, kindly; a teacher may call the parent; crisis words get the crisis line

steps.name: Waiver on the secure page
steps.result: not signed in 10 minutes: nothing is booked

steps.name: Pick-up list on the secure page
steps.result: no adult on the list: the child isn't released at pick-up

steps.name: Health questions on the secure page
steps.result: the booking goes on; any yes is read by the teacher before the first day

first_steps_and_forms.prep: a snack, a water bottle, and clothes the child can get messy in; a photo ID for the adult who picks up

staff.skills: homework help, science, art, reading, coding, sports, music; the age groups each teacher may work with
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each teacher's certificate or background check, the business's own word, never checked by Rosie
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs late pick-ups, extra days, home and school programs and refunds
staff.stand_in: another teacher the owner has cleared for the age group; a home or school program that named a teacher is asked first, and nobody moves on silence
staff.ratio: up to 12 children per teacher; younger children at 8 per teacher

children_and_age.who_may_book: a parent or guardian for each child; a school's office books an in-school program; a child is never booked by someone who isn't on the child's record
children_and_age.minors_texts: texts go to the parent or guardian who booked

visit.check_in: the teacher ticks each child on the roster at the door when the parent drops them off
visit.done: the teacher texts DONE once the last child is picked up
visit.changes_at_visit: an extra day or an extra hour is priced first and the parent says yes; nothing is added to a term

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: none from the state for enrichment or tutoring in most places; where the state licenses a child-care or after-school program, the business shows its own license only once it is on file; teachers hold the certificates the business says they hold (the business's own word)
license.who: the business, for its registration and any child-care or after-school license; each teacher, for their own certificate or background check where the rules ask
license.ask: the business registration; any child-care license number; each teacher's certificate and its end date
license.insurance: liability insurance: the business's own word, shown once it is sent
license.background: background checks for every teacher and volunteer who works with children: the business's own word, where the rules ask

never_in_a_text: a child's name and age, health notes, a learning need or a pick-up detail in texts to anyone but the parent: only on the secure page
